notes: Report Iran's claim as a claim: Iran's army said an unnamed oil tanker struck naval mines and caught fire in a prohibited area east of the Strait of Hormuz on 27 October, the statement was carried by IRNA, no ship, flag, crew or casualty details were given and there is no independent confirmation. Drop the Riyadh explosions and Zoom News from this item: those were Houthi missile attacks on land with no ship hit.

Name the tanker of UKMTO warnings 181-26 and 182-26 as the Leonora Kosan, an LPG tanker under the Singapore flag (IMO 9390953), struck by an unknown projectile 6 nautical miles northeast of Limah, Oman, on 23 October and disabled, with the crew safe, as the IMO confirmed incidents register and JMIC update 108 record. Never call her a bulk carrier, and never mention the Cape Dao, a different ship struck on 23 September that sank east of Sohar on 14 October.

Give the fire off Al-Faw once, as UKMTO warning 183-26 of 26 October recorded it from multiple third party reports, a vessel on fire 63 nautical miles southeast of Al-Faw: the name, cause, damage and crew status are unknown, so credit UKMTO, do not credit Iran, and do not call it a sinking.
